title: O People, Come and Be Clean Ones!
body:
As-salaamu `alaykum! Dastoor yaa RijaalAllah, madad. As-salaamu `alaykum, haadireen wa gha`ibeen,
those who are attending here, and everyone throughout east and west who is attending to hear something. It
is an honor to hear heavenly words and to ask from heavenly ones to correct our positions and to support
weak Muslim servants against shaytanic groups. May Allah, as He likes, take them away to an unknown
direction or bring them for hearing and listening from heavenly words that give them honor. And we are
saying, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. (Mawlana Shaykh stands) Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'rRaheem! That is for our Lord's t`azheem wa takreem, most high respect to our Creator and our Lord, Allah
Almighty, to stand and say, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
O People! Keep that honor, don't forget! Who is forgetting, Allah Almighty is going to forget him. If a person
is forgotten, there is no chance for that one here or Hereafter. O attenders throughout east and west, it is a
humble meeting here, but technology is taking this humble association throughout east and west. Take care
and be followers of the holy commands of Allah Almighty! All of us are servants. Don't be cheated by Shaytan
and its agents, who say imitated titles give you more than what obediency gives, or that imitated titles never
take away your honor from servanthood. Servanthood is the last horizon for Mankind! Lordship is only for
the Creator Who created.

O our Attenders! Hear, listen and try to understand! We are on the last stage of Mankind, the last level, and
other levels are going up, up, up and our addressing is to the most simple ones. And to be simple ones is
better than to be complicated. Complication is giving nothing to you, but simpleness is always good for
servants. Servants must try to be simple ones, but our egos are never happy to be simple ones. Our ego is a
student of Shaytan and Shaytan is the teacher of everyone and everyone has an ego and egoistic desires. Now
we are living in the 21st century, when all peoples' requests are egoistic desires. They are requesting egoistic
requests, everyone, except that is mentioned in hadeeth nabawi ash-shareef, Sayyidina Muhammad (s).
(Mawlana Shaykh stands) That standing up is making our egos very angry and more than our egos, Shaytan
is going to be very, very, very angry. Ptuu (spit) on Shaytan and its followers! (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
Marhaban, marhaban! Try to be ahlan, suitable for accepting ahlan wa sahlan, that welcoming angels are
saying for some ones when they are leaving this life, "Ahlan wa sahlan! Ahlan wa sahlan!" Try to be from
those people that angels will welcome by saying, Ahlan wa sahlan, "Welcome good servants!" All of us are
servants but some of us are good servants, some of us are bad servants. Try to be good servants! Who are
good servants? Those who are following prophets, particularly the Seal of Prophets, the most glorified one
and most honored one in the Divine Presence, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits)
Those who are following him are good servants and others are bad servants. Who are they? They are
followers of Shaytan and ifreet.
Look on which table is written your name, under good servants' table, or under bad servants' table? Both are
servants. No one can get out from servanthood but some of them are accepting that they are servants and are
trying to follow His divinely orders. Everyone that is following the orders of the Lord of Heavens is dressed in
the dress of honor. But egoistic people that are always running to make their egos pleased and in pleasure,
and those bad servants are coming on the Day of Resurrection and sent under the flag of Shaytan and its
followers. Bad servants will be taken on that way, the left way. All leftists are bad servants under the dirty flag
of Shaytan and on Judgment Day they will be taken from there and put in front of Shaytan and they will
follow Shaytan, who represents bad servanthood. Now the whole world is running under Shaytan's dirty flag
and thinking they are doing their best, but they are never doing their best! The best-doing people are those
who are following good ones, who are followers of holy commands of Heavens.

O People! Try to hear, listen and understand! It is so easy and simple, and our missions are so simple. All of
us are servants, but some of us are good servants and some are bad servants. Look, you are going to take your
way as you were following in this life. Those who are following the worst way will be taken on the bad
servanthood wing.
•••••• ••••••••••• ••••••••• ••••••••••• •••••••
Wa hum yahsaboona annahum yuhsinoona suna`a.
they reckon that they do good work. (Al-Kahf, 18:104)
O Salafi `ulamas! Now you must teach people. That is one part of a holy verse from the Holy Qur'an that is
giving a full description of Shaytan's followers. Bad servants are thinking, yahsaboona annahum yuhsinoona
suna`a, they are running in sewage channels, saying, "We are doing our best." Now this dirtiness is running
in it, so how are you saying this? Therefore, there are two kinds of life for people now: some are asking for a
clean life, honored and glorified life, and others are running after sewage channels, thinking that is the best.
Therefore, now living ones are on two ways. The majority are sewage channels' followers, who like it and who
never understand forbidden things, saying, "We are not taking any care for prohibited things, no! What is
pleasurable for us, we are running in it. We are not looking if this is haraam, forbidden, no. What is making
our egos happy and in pleasure, we are running in it." And on the Day of Resurrection, they are going to look,
"Where are we? We are in sewage channels."
O People! If we are saying one percent are asking for a clean life, don't be surprised. We may say ninety-nine
percent are never taking any care for haraam and halaal, never asking what is dirty or clean. They are only
running after their egoistic desires, may be as a pig, if one of them is dead, others are coming on it and eating.
Therefore, Allah Almighty is making it haraam, prohibited to eat pig meat. Pigs are dirty ones because they
are eating dirty, they are even eating their dead ones. And people say, "O! What delicious food today." They
are dirty and eating their dirtiness also, but Mankind is not thinking on it and saying, "Why did Allah
Almighty prohibit His servants to eat pigs?" Now so many young ones who have been cheated by Shaytan's
agents are saying, "Why are we not eating pigs' meat?" I am saying because pigs are eating dirty and eating
other ones' dead also. Twenty-first century people are never trying to distinguish, tamiyyiz, between clean
ones and dirty ones, halaal and haraam. They are saying, "Eat dirtiness!" Hasha! I am saying to those
Shaytan followers, if you are saying, "It doesn't matter," we are saying one day you may fall in a dirty well,

then eat and drink there until you die! All prophets came to teach people cleanliness and Islam's first
command is, be clean! But Shaytan never likes to be clean, and they are saying clean is dirty and dirty is clean.
O People! Use your minds! Now we are in the holy month of Ramadan Mubarak. Mubaarak for you!
Mubaarak for those who are giving their high respects to this holy month, and we are asking from holy ones a
protection from our egos and egoistic desires, to cut it in this holy month, and not to come back to that
carcass. Someone may say that a carcass is dirty. Perhaps someone is leaving and going away, all of them are
going away, but some of them after Ramadan are saying, "It doesn't matter, we must come back to our
carcass." No, Ramadan is coming to clean the ummah, (Mawlana Shaykh stands) the nation of Sayyidina
Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
When you are going to be clean, don't come once again to walk in or to eat and drink from dirty sewage
channels. We may say this now up to the next Jumu`ah, and it is never finishing, but the main point that we
are reminding Mankind is, "O People! Come and be clean ones!" If not, you know what may happen.
May Allah forgive us, for the honor of the Seal of Prophets (s), for the honor of His full-honored month, fully
ornamented with Laylat al-Qadr. Keep your high respect in this Ramadan Mubarak. Allah knows who can
reach to the coming Ramadan. Don't say, "I am young." Yes, young people hope to live, but those who are like
me or a little bit younger must not give a chance to their egos that, "Next year, you may live." This year is like
an open market; you may take as you like, but next year this market may be closed or you can't reach to that
second market. Beware of Shaytan! We are cleaning in this month and we are asking from the Lord of
Heavens for the honor of His most honored one, not prevent us from falling into again in dirty sewage
channels.
May Allah forgive us. Tawbah yaa Rabbee, tawbah astaghfirullah. Tawbah yaa Rabbee, tawbah astaghfirullah.
La ilaaha illa-Llah. La ilaaha illa-Llah. La ilaaha illa-Llah Sayyidina Muhammadun Rasoolullah (s)! (Mawlana
Shaykh stands and sits)
Fatihah.
(34 minutes)
